title: 实验室里的行为规范
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training Series/05_Behavior Lab Safety Video Part 3.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training Series/05_Behavior Lab Safety Video Part 3/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a lab bench and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全系列第三课：实验室里的行为。

shots.scene: 俯瞰一间忙碌的实验室
shots.prompt_en: A high-angle view of a busy teaching lab with people working at several benches.
shots.narration: 看看大家在实验室里该怎么做。

shots.scene: 阿杰走进实验室，台面上瓶瓶罐罐堆得满满
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into the lab toward a bench crowded with bottles and equipment.
shots.narration: 阿杰今天要在这张台子上做实验。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，示意他先听欣欣讲规矩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and gestures for him to listen first.
shots.narration: 小研说：动手前，先把规矩弄清楚。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室里出镜，双手比出一个大圆
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera in the lab and spreads both arms in a big circle gesture.
shots.narration: 尊重实验室，也尊重你的同事。

shots.scene: 小研、阿杰和老周在实验台旁友好交谈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, the young male student and the older man talk together at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 你的行为，决定实验室对大家是否安全。

shots.scene: 小研在一排天平旁操作酸度计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student operates a pH meter next to a row of balances with blank name plates.
shots.narration: 首先，要按书面的标准操作规程。

shots.scene: 小研一边看空白规程文件一边操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank standard operating procedure document and follows it while working.
shots.narration: 一步一步照着做。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套操作小型离心机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, operates a small benchtop centrifuge.
shots.narration: 在实验室里，绝不吃东西、喝水，

shots.scene: 小研戴着手套涂唇膏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, still wearing lab gloves, applies lipstick beside a stirrer.
shots.narration: 不嚼口香糖，也不化妆。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴着手套和护目镜举起水杯喝水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing gloves and goggles, raises a drinking cup to his mouth.
shots.narration: 这样可能沾污皮肤，吃进有毒化学品。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室里出镜，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera in the lab and shakes its head.
shots.narration: 还可能污染实验，毁掉结果。

shots.scene: 小研独自在天平罩旁操作，实验室里没有别人
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works alone at a balance enclosure in an otherwise empty lab.
shots.narration: 绝不单独工作。

shots.scene: 老周走进来，两人同在实验室，彼此能看见
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks in, and the two of them work within sight of each other.
shots.narration: 至少还有一人在场，紧急时互相帮忙。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室里出镜，指向身后
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera and points behind itself to the lab.
shots.narration: 良好内务，也能预防事故。

shots.scene: 乱糟糟的实验室图标上方亮起警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a messy lab room with clutter everywhere and a yellow warning triangle above it. No people.
shots.narration: 杂乱的实验室，就是危险的实验室。

shots.scene: 地上一团纸，穿工作鞋的脚走过
shots.prompt_en: A crumpled paper towel on the lab floor as a foot in a work shoe walks past. No faces.
shots.narration: 清掉地上会让人滑倒绊倒的杂物。

shots.scene: 小研从地上提起一桶试剂放回台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts a reagent jug from the floor and puts it back on the bench.
shots.narration: 绝不把化学品瓶放在地上，

shots.scene: 地上放着两瓶有色溶液，阿杰蹲下拿取
shots.prompt_en: Two bottles of colored solution sit on the floor, and the young male student crouches to pick them up.
shots.narration: 哪怕只是临时放一下，也不行。

shots.scene: 小研翻开一份空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank safety data sheet next to a small spill on the floor.
shots.narration: 万一洒了，先查安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 拖把和水桶，旁边立着黄色小心地滑警示牌
shots.prompt_en: A mop and bucket beside a yellow wet floor caution sign on the lab floor. No people.
shots.narration: 一般洒漏立即清理，放好防滑警示牌。

shots.scene: 阿杰用喷壶清洁台面，小研整理仪器台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student cleans a bench with a spray bottle while the female graduate student tidies an instrument bench.
shots.narration: 台面保持整洁有序，只放需要的。

shots.scene: 不用的瓶子被收回柜子里
shots.prompt_en: Unused bottles are put back into a closed cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 用不着的东西，都收起来。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手把台边的烧杯往里推
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pushes a beaker back from the edge toward the middle of the bench. No faces.
shots.narration: 东西别放台边，一碰就掉。

shots.scene: 玻璃器皿摔在地上碎开的慢镜头
shots.prompt_en: A slow-motion shot of a glass flask falling to the lab floor and shattering. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃，绝不能徒手捡。

shots.scene: 玻璃划破手指，化学品随伤口进入的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a glass shard cutting a finger with chemical drops entering the cut. No people.
shots.narration: 割伤刺伤会把化学品直接带进血液。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套蹲下，用刷子和簸箕扫碎玻璃
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, crouches and sweeps broken glass into a dustpan with a brush.
shots.narration: 用刷子和簸箕来收拾。

shots.scene: 碎玻璃倒进一个空白标签的碎玻璃收集箱
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass is poured from a dustpan into a sturdy cardboard broken glass box with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃放进指定的收集容器。

shots.scene: 小研在水槽边清洗玻璃器皿，放上晾干架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes glassware at a lab sink and places it on a drying rack.
shots.narration: 实验结束，把玻璃器皿洗净晾干。

shots.scene: 手把试剂瓶放回柜中
shots.prompt_en: A hand puts reagent bottles back into a storage cabinet. No faces.
shots.narration: 试剂放回储存区。

shots.scene: 小研用喷壶和纸擦拭台面，旁边立着气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the bench with a spray bottle and paper towels, a gas cylinder standing nearby.
shots.narration: 再用乙醇或异丙醇擦净台面。

shots.scene: 阿杰发现电线破损，转身去找老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices a frayed power cord on the bench and turns to find the older man.
shots.narration: 发生违规，或看到任何不安全情况，

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告，老周点头记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man, who nods and writes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 立即报告你的主管。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，身后实验室整洁有序
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up in front of a clean, orderly lab.
shots.narration: 规范好自己的行为。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向一排化学品危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a row of chemical hazard pictograms on a blank board.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲实验室常见的化学品危害。

shots.scene: 规程、禁止饮食、两人同在三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a procedure binder, a no eating and drinking sign and two people side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 按规程做，不饮食化妆，不单独做。

shots.scene: 整洁台面、地面无杂物、试剂不落地图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tidy bench, a clean floor and a reagent bottle on a shelf instead of the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 台面整洁，地面干净，试剂不落地。

shots.scene: 簸箕扫玻璃、喷壶擦台面、报告图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dustpan with broken glass, a spray bottle wiping a bench and a person reporting. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃不徒手，收尾擦台，隐患上报。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the door of a clean, orderly lab.
shots.narration: 好习惯保安全，下次见！
